## Goal
Complete task `provisioning-fusion-20261019` in `/srv/git/odbus-verified`: diagnose why the existing identity-container provisioning workflow remains unfinished, review the complete supplied Hermes/Astra/Claude/Kiro public histories and linked workers, reconstruct drift, and produce an evidence-backed modification specification for the **existing** workflow.

Deliver under `reports/provisioning-fusion-20261019/analysis/`:
- `diagnosis.md`
- `drift-ledger.md`
- `proposed-changes.md`
- `decisions.jsonl`
- Accurate ingestion, coverage, and completion receipts
- Actual native JEV judgments with exact inputs, rubrics, answers, provenance, and uncertainty

Do not implement or provision.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **NO HOST LOOP DEVICES**, including existing pool backing, seed wrappers, and per-instance mappings. Existing `/dev/loop0` is a conflict, not an exemption or permission to detach it.
- Prefer no disk images and subvolumes only **if all retained semantics survive**.
- Preserve immutable shared Btrfs seed/sprout semantics, isolated persistent writes, separate upgrade replica, send/receive, correct root composition, unprivileged Incus, identity admission, storage proofs, durable intents/recovery, authoritative adoption, and startup.
- Bootstrap already exists and is out of scope. Preserve existing identity/session/native UUID/creation records.
- No new provisioning script, orchestrator, endpoint, control plane, LVM management, VM conversion, copied-root substitution, or silent snapshot replacement.
- Writes only under `reports/provisioning-fusion-20261019/analysis/`. Do not change source, runtime, storage, grants, credentials, services, normal OMP config, `HANDOFF.md`, or `SIGNALS.md`.
- No builds, tests, formatters, deployment, provisioning helpers, historical command replay, or unauthorized runtime inspection. Use supplied redacted exports; never authentication stores or unredacted histories.
- JEV judges evidence and decisions, **never models or authorization**. Use native typed `judge`/`judge_batch`, configured role `typesafe/jev-latest`; record actual resolved backend.
- **Recovery execution restrictions:** no new agents, workpools, or parallel completion batches. At most **one outstanding explicit completion globally**; await and checkpoint before the next.
- For stateless packet reading, use native `smol`, not default Fusion. Prior scout resolved to `openai-codex/gpt-6-astra`; record actual resolution rather than assuming it.
- Do not directly invoke internal `litellm_fusion`; the prior run already violated its per-request restriction.
- Do not regenerate exports/packets or repeat completed source research.
- Full availability/mechanical parsing is not semantic review. Preserve every original record, duplicate reference, correction, active/compacted flag, parent link, and source date.
- On provider failure, save partial state and return the exact error rather than substituting providers.
- All ten mandatory skills were injected in context; additional relevant skills were read in the prior run. Read applicable session guidance when continuing.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Read original `CASE.md`, owner corrections, initial judgments, and manifest during the prior run.
- [x] Prior run mechanically parsed **42 histories, 6,620 records, 36,878,073 raw bytes**.
- [x] Existing packet artifacts preserve original records with exact repeated-string references:
  - `analysis/packet-index.json`: **294 history packets**, `history-000` through `history-293`.
  - `analysis/supplement-index.json`: **40 supplement packets**.
  - `analysis/record-index.json`
  - `analysis/duplicate-index.json`
  - `analysis/packets/*.txt`
  - `analysis/review-contract.txt`
  - `analysis/mandatory-preload.txt`
- [x] Read `recovery/checkpoint.json` completely in the resumed run.
- [x] Read saved `recovery/SourceChain.md` completely, lines 1–546.
- [x] Read saved `recovery/BackendProof.md` lines 1–300; remainder outstanding.
- [x] Read saved `recovery/NativeFeasibility.md` lines 1–260 and much of 261–572; the latter output was capped near its coverage table. Read the tail explicitly.
- [x] Read saved `recovery/HistoricalScripts.md` through EOF. **The saved file itself is truncated mid-citation** at `B:\`deploy/scripts/pro`; its opening claims complete historical review, but its preserved detailed report is incomplete.
- [x] Read parent `jev-evidence-inputs.json` and `jev-evidence-decisions.json` completely.
